about: Stated as a conjecture: a field of cells with origins and signatures is a game with a referee inside it, and five properties hold in each of five readings of it.

The properties: a move is a claim; a claim alone is potential; two that meet are information; a signature moves every cell that rests on it; and no player may suspend the rule that makes the first four.
No numbers. What is claimed is that each of the five readings matches all five properties.
